meta.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
meta.source_filename: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle (2017) Dual Audio {Hindi-English} Movie| 1080p BluRay.mkv
description: In this fresh adventure, four high-school students discover an old video-game console and find themselves unexpectedly drawn straight into its jungle setting. Upon entering this world, the teenagers realize they have literally transformed into the adult avatars they selected. They quickly learn that Jumanji is not a game you simply play, but a dangerous environment that they must actively survive.

To beat the game and return to the real world, the group must embark on the most perilous adventure of their lives. Success requires them to uncover what Alex Vreeke left behind two decades prior, as well as change the way they think about themselves. If they fail, they face being trapped inside the game forever, endlessly played by others without a break.
